root_cause: Technical modules, textual journeys and dense dashboards occupy cognitive space before the entrepreneur can explore the relationship between ambition, sources, decision and actual measured result. A previous textual evidence flow did not make missing proof easy to discover interactively.
fix: A bounded interactive company orbit embedded inside the original logged-in entrepreneur decision hero, reusing the original authenticated buildEntrepreneurJourneyModel. Five independent evidence stages remain distinct and unknown or unsupported outcomes never become green. UI interactions write nothing; no duplicate tenant state, scheduler, provider, AI inference or action executor.
prevention_rules: Every new portal hero must preserve one primary useful action and authenticated company context; keep technical pages progressive.
Separate a confirmed scan, saved goal, source proof, supported proposal and independently verified outcome; never create a false cumulative health score.
Guest/demo never receives a customer evidence visualization; never trust cross-tenant mutable snapshots while hydrating.
No Red Dot, WCAG or user-success claim before independent accessible browser, user, jury or audit proof.
Never bypass original GitHub admission, CodeQL, Required, BRAIN, protected merge and exact production readback; verify the PR body contains all four mandatory admission fields before opening.
